name: neoize
description: Turn a codebase and its hard-won knowledge into a local Neo4j graph Claude queries by relevance, instead of a wiki nobody reads.

neo4j_container.title: Neo4j container name
neo4j_container.description: Name of the local Docker container the graph runs in. The shipped compose uses neoize-neo4j.

neo4j_password.title: Neo4j password
neo4j_password.description: Password for that user. A local loopback throwaway by default; change it only if you changed the container's own password.
